verdict.rationale: cubic documents several context sources for reviews beyond the diff. It auto-uses repo context files (README.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .ai/), learns team conventions from feedback and historical senior reviews, and links related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs and schemas that need matching updates. However, no first-party doc explicitly says PR review comments analyze in-repo call sites or related modules outside the changed hunks; the 'reads the rest of your codebase' claim is made only for the archived AI chat sidebar. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that reviews trace call sites and dependent modules across the whole repo, and independent or hands-on corroboration of repo-aware review comments.
